package ai // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/ai"

Package ai defines the provider-neutral message, tool, request, and streaming
contracts used by the agent runtime.

Stability: since v1.0 the exported API follows the policy in STABILITY.md at the
repository root.

FUNCTIONS

func ApplyPayloadHook(ctx context.Context, params any) error
    ApplyPayloadHook lets OnPayload inspect or replace a provider request body.
    The body is round-tripped through JSON and decoded back into params.
    Adapters that encode through HookHTTPClient get this automatically; this
    helper is for adapters that want to hook before encoding.

func CloneRawMessage(raw json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage
    CloneRawMessage deep-copies a JSON payload.

func EmitProviderStreamEvent(ctx context.Context, event any) error
    EmitProviderStreamEvent forwards one raw provider event to the observer.

func GetCurrentSystemPrompt(messages []Message) string
    GetCurrentSystemPrompt renders the replayed system message: content followed
    by named sections. Sections are rendered in name order so the result is
    deterministic.

func HookHTTPClient(base *http.Client) *http.Client
    HookHTTPClient wraps a client's transport so identity headers are applied
    and OnResponse observes the raw HTTP response.

func IsRetryable(err error) bool
    IsRetryable reports whether an error represents a transient provider or
    transport failure. APIError.Retryable is authoritative when set.

func RenderSystemMessage(system SystemMessage) string
    RenderSystemMessage renders a system message's content and sections.

func Retry(ctx context.Context, policy RetryPolicy, op func(context.Context) error) error
    Retry runs op until it succeeds, returns a non-retryable error, or exhausts
    the configured retry budget. Context cancellation interrupts backoff.

func RetryDelay(policy RetryPolicy, attempt int) time.Duration
    RetryDelay returns the delay before the given 1-indexed retry attempt.

func ValidateTransport(transport Transport) error
    ValidateTransport rejects transports GOAT cannot serve.

func WithRequestHooks(ctx context.Context, options RequestOptions, provider string) context.Context
    WithRequestHooks attaches per-request hooks and identity to the context used
    by provider adapters.


TYPES

type API string
    API identifies a provider protocol.

const (
	APIOpenAICompletions    API = "openai-completions"
	APIOpenAIResponses      API = "openai-responses"
	APIAzureOpenAIResponses API = "azure-openai-responses"
	APIGoogleGenerativeAI   API = "google-generative-ai"
	APIAnthropicMessages    API = "anthropic-messages"
)
type APIError struct {
	Provider   string
	StatusCode int
	Code       string
	Message    string
	RequestID  string
	Retryable  bool
	Err        error
}
    APIError is the provider-neutral error returned by model adapters.

func (e *APIError) Error() string

func (e *APIError) Unwrap() error

type AssistantMessage struct {
	Content  []ContentBlock `json:"content"`
	API      API            `json:"api,omitempty"`
	Provider string         `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Model    string         `json:"model,omitempty"`
	// ResponseModel is the concrete model reported by the provider, when reported.
	ResponseModel string `json:"responseModel,omitempty"`
	// ResponseID is a provider-specific response or message identifier.
	ResponseID string `json:"responseId,omitempty"`
	// ProviderThinkingLevel is the exact provider-native effort level used.
	ProviderThinkingLevel string `json:"providerThinkingLevel,omitempty"`
	// ThinkingLevel is the pi thinking level requested for this response.
	ThinkingLevel ThinkingLevel   `json:"thinkingLevel,omitempty"`
	Diagnostics   []Diagnostic    `json:"diagnostics,omitempty"`
	Usage         Usage           `json:"usage"`
	StopReason    StopReason      `json:"stopReason,omitempty"`
	Deferred      *DeferredHandle `json:"deferred,omitempty"`
	ErrorMessage  string          `json:"errorMessage,omitempty"`
	RawStopReason string          `json:"rawStopReason,omitempty"`
	// EndTurn reports whether the model explicitly ended its turn.
	EndTurn    bool  `json:"endTurn,omitempty"`
	At         int64 `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
	DurationMs int64 `json:"durationMs,omitempty"`
}
    AssistantMessage is a model turn.

func AsAssistant(message Message) *AssistantMessage
    AsAssistant returns the message as an assistant message, or nil.

func NewAssistantMessage(content ...ContentBlock) *AssistantMessage
    NewAssistantMessage creates an assistant message.

func (m AssistantMessage) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
    MarshalJSON adds the role discriminator to an assistant message.

func (m *AssistantMessage) Role() Role
    Role implements Message.

func (m *AssistantMessage) Text() string

func (m *AssistantMessage) Thinking() string

func (m *AssistantMessage) Timestamp() int64

func (m *AssistantMessage) ToolCalls() []ToolCall

type Attribution struct {
	Name       string
	URL        string
	Categories []string
}
    Attribution identifies the calling app to providers that support routing
    headers (currently OpenRouter).

type BlockType string
    BlockType identifies a content block within a message.

const (
	BlockText     BlockType = "text"
	BlockThinking BlockType = "thinking"
	BlockImage    BlockType = "image"
	BlockToolCall BlockType = "toolCall"
)
type ContentBlock struct {
	Type              BlockType     `json:"type"`
	Text              string        `json:"text,omitempty"`
	TextSignature     string        `json:"textSignature,omitempty"`
	Thinking          string        `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
	ThinkingSignature string        `json:"thinkingSignature,omitempty"`
	ID                string        `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Redacted          bool          `json:"redacted,omitempty"`
	Image             *ImageContent `json:"image,omitempty"`
	ToolCall          *ToolCall     `json:"toolCall,omitempty"`
}
    ContentBlock is one piece of provider-neutral message content.

func CloneContentBlock(block ContentBlock) ContentBlock
    CloneContentBlock deep-copies a content block.

func CloneContentBlocks(blocks []ContentBlock) []ContentBlock
    CloneContentBlocks deep-copies content blocks.

type Context struct {
	SystemPrompt string
	Messages     []Message
	Tools        []ToolSpec
}
    Context is request input accepted by the public entry points. SystemPrompt
    and Tools are shorthand for a leading system message; NormalizeContext folds
    them into one before a provider sees the request.

type Cost struct {
	Input      float64 `json:"input"`
	Output     float64 `json:"output"`
	CacheRead  float64 `json:"cacheRead"`
	CacheWrite float64 `json:"cacheWrite"`
	Total      float64 `json:"total"`
	// TotalFromProvider is true when Total is billed cost reported by the
	// provider rather than a catalog estimate.
	TotalFromProvider bool `json:"totalFromProvider,omitempty"`
}
    Cost is the monetary cost of one request.

type DeferredHandle struct {
	Provider    string          `json:"provider"`
	ModelID     string          `json:"modelId"`
	API         string          `json:"api"`
	ID          string          `json:"id"`
	ExpiresAt   int64           `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
	PollAfterMs int64           `json:"pollAfterMs,omitempty"`
	Data        json.RawMessage `json:"data,omitempty"`
}
    DeferredHandle identifies a provider-side deferred response.

type Diagnostic struct {
	Type      string           `json:"type"`
	Timestamp int64            `json:"timestamp"`
	Error     *DiagnosticError `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Details   json.RawMessage  `json:"details,omitempty"`
}
    Diagnostic is a redacted provider or runtime diagnostic attached to an
    assistant message.

type DiagnosticError struct {
	Name    string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Stack   string `json:"stack,omitempty"`
	Code    any    `json:"code,omitempty"`
}
    DiagnosticError describes the captured failure of a diagnostic.

type Event struct {
	Type          EventType      `json:"type"`
	ContentIndex  int            `json:"content_index,omitempty"`
	Text          string         `json:"text,omitempty"`
	TextDelta     string         `json:"text_delta,omitempty"`
	Thinking      string         `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
	ThinkingDelta string         `json:"thinking_delta,omitempty"`
	ToolCall      *ToolCall      `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
	ToolCallDelta *ToolCallDelta `json:"tool_call_delta,omitempty"`
	Partial       Message        `json:"partial,omitempty"`
	Message       Message        `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Usage         *Usage         `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	StopReason    StopReason     `json:"stop_reason,omitempty"`
	Err           error          `json:"-"`
	Error         string         `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
    Event is one normalized model stream event. Partial is a deep copy of the
    assistant message accumulated so far. Done carries Message and Usage;
    Error carries Err and the partial message.

type EventType string
    EventType identifies one normalized model stream event.

const (
	EventStart         EventType = "start"
	EventTextStart     EventType = "text_start"
	EventTextDelta     EventType = "text_delta"
	EventTextEnd       EventType = "text_end"
	EventThinkingStart EventType = "thinking_start"
	EventThinkingDelta EventType = "thinking_delta"
	EventThinkingEnd   EventType = "thinking_end"
	EventToolCallStart EventType = "tool_call_start"
	EventToolCallDelta EventType = "tool_call_delta"
	EventToolCallEnd   EventType = "tool_call_end"
	EventUsage         EventType = "usage"
	EventDone          EventType = "done"
	EventError         EventType = "error"
)
type Identity struct {
	UserAgent   string
	Attribution *Attribution
}
    Identity overrides request identification headers.

type ImageContent struct {
	Data     string `json:"data,omitempty"`
	URL      string `json:"url,omitempty"`
	MimeType string `json:"mimeType,omitempty"`
}
    ImageContent is an inline image or image URL.

type Message interface {
	Role() Role
	Text() string
	Thinking() string
	ToolCalls() []ToolCall
	Timestamp() int64
	// Has unexported methods.
}
    Message is one provider-neutral transcript message. It is a closed union:
    only the four message types in this package implement it.

func CloneMessage(message Message) Message
    CloneMessage deep-copies a message.

func CloneMessages(messages []Message) []Message
    CloneMessages deep-copies a message slice.

func TextMessage(role Role, text string) Message
    TextMessage creates a message of the given role containing one text block.

func ToolMessage(callID, toolName, text string) Message
    ToolMessage creates a successful text tool-result message.

func ToolTextMessage(callID, toolName, text string, isError bool) Message
    ToolTextMessage creates a tool-result message containing one text block.

func UnmarshalMessage(data []byte) (Message, error)
    UnmarshalMessage decodes one message using its role discriminator.

func UnmarshalMessages(data []byte) ([]Message, error)
    UnmarshalMessages decodes a JSON array of messages.

type Model interface {
	Info() ModelInfo
	Stream(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Stream, error)
}
    Model is the boundary between the agent loop and a model provider.

type ModelInfo struct {
	Provider                 string `json:"provider"`
	Model                    string `json:"model"`
	API                      API    `json:"api"`
	ContextWindow            int    `json:"context_window,omitempty"`
	MaxOutputTokens          int    `json:"max_output_tokens,omitempty"`
	SupportsTools            bool   `json:"supports_tools"`
	SupportsImages           bool   `json:"supports_images,omitempty"`
	SupportsToolResultImages bool   `json:"supports_tool_result_images,omitempty"`
	SupportsThinking         bool   `json:"supports_thinking,omitempty"`
	// Reasoning reports whether the model exposes a reasoning/thinking mode.
	Reasoning bool `json:"reasoning,omitempty"`
	// ThinkingLevels lists explicitly supported levels. Empty means off..high
	// when Reasoning is true; xhigh and max always require an explicit entry.
	ThinkingLevels []ThinkingLevel `json:"thinking_levels,omitempty"`
	// Pricing is the per-million-token price used by Usage.ApplyCost.
	Pricing ModelPricing `json:"pricing,omitempty"`
}
    ModelInfo describes a concrete model and the protocol capabilities exposed
    by its adapter. Model-specific limitations still apply.

func (info ModelInfo) ClampThinkingLevel(level ThinkingLevel) ThinkingLevel
    ClampThinkingLevel returns the requested level when supported, otherwise the
    closest supported lower level.

func (info ModelInfo) SupportsThinkingLevel(level ThinkingLevel) bool
    SupportsThinkingLevel reports whether the model accepts the level.

type ModelPricing struct {
	Input      float64 `json:"input,omitempty"`
	Output     float64 `json:"output,omitempty"`
	CacheRead  float64 `json:"cache_read,omitempty"`
	CacheWrite float64 `json:"cache_write,omitempty"`
}
    ModelPricing is a per-million-token price table.

func (p ModelPricing) ApplyCost(usage *Usage)
    ApplyCost fills usage.Cost from the pricing table.

func (p ModelPricing) Calculate(usage Usage) Cost
    Calculate returns the cost of one usage report at this price table.
    Anthropic 1h cache writes are billed at twice the base input rate.

type NestedToolCallRecord struct {
	ID             string          `json:"id"`
	Name           string          `json:"name"`
	Arguments      json.RawMessage `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
	ArgumentsBytes int             `json:"argumentsBytes,omitempty"`
	Status         string          `json:"status"`
	DurationMs     int64           `json:"durationMs,omitempty"`
	Error          string          `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
    NestedToolCallRecord is a tool call another tool made while it ran.

type NestedToolCalls struct {
	Calls    []NestedToolCallRecord `json:"calls"`
	Complete bool                   `json:"complete"`
}
    NestedToolCalls is a bounded record of the calls a tool made.

type Request struct {
	Messages []Message      `json:"messages"`
	Tools    []ToolSpec     `json:"tools,omitempty"`
	Options  RequestOptions `json:"options,omitempty"`
}
    Request is one provider-neutral model turn.

type RequestOptions struct {
	Temperature          *float64   `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	TopP                 *float64   `json:"top_p,omitempty"`
	MaxTokens            int        `json:"max_tokens,omitempty"`
	ToolChoice           ToolChoice `json:"tool_choice,omitempty"`
	SessionID            string     `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	ReasoningEffort      string     `json:"reasoning_effort,omitempty"`
	ThinkingBudgetTokens int        `json:"thinking_budget_tokens,omitempty"`

	// APIKey overrides the provider credential for this request.
	APIKey string `json:"-"`
	// OnPayload inspects or replaces the provider request body. Returning nil
	// keeps the payload unchanged.
	OnPayload func(map[string]any) (map[string]any, error) `json:"-"`
	// OnResponse observes the raw HTTP response before its body is consumed.
	OnResponse func(status int, headers http.Header) error `json:"-"`
	// OnProviderStreamEvent observes each raw provider stream event before
	// normalization.
	OnProviderStreamEvent func(event any) error `json:"-"`
	// Identity overrides User-Agent and provider attribution headers.
	Identity *Identity `json:"-"`
	// Transport selects a preferred transport; GOAT rejects "websocket".
	Transport Transport `json:"transport,omitempty"`
	// TimeoutMs caps the provider request duration when the adapter supports it.
	TimeoutMs int `json:"timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	// MaxRetries caps client-side retries when the adapter supports it.
	MaxRetries int `json:"max_retries,omitempty"`
	// MaxRetryDelayMs caps provider-requested retry delays. Adapters that rely
	// on SDK retries ignore it.
	MaxRetryDelayMs int `json:"max_retry_delay_ms,omitempty"`
	// SamplingParams is merged into OpenAI-compatible request bodies.
	SamplingParams map[string]any `json:"sampling_params,omitempty"`
}
    RequestOptions contains per-request sampling and routing controls. Empty
    values leave the provider default in place.

type RetryPolicy struct {
	Enabled    bool
	MaxRetries int
	BaseDelay  time.Duration
	MaxDelay   time.Duration
}
    RetryPolicy controls bounded retries with exponential backoff. MaxRetries is
    the number of retries after the initial call.

type Role string
    Role identifies the author of a message.

const (
	RoleSystem    Role = "system"
	RoleUser      Role = "user"
	RoleAssistant Role = "assistant"
	// RoleToolResult is pi's tool-result role name.
	RoleToolResult Role = "toolResult"
	// Deprecated: use RoleToolResult.
	RoleTool = RoleToolResult
)
type StopReason string
    StopReason describes why a model turn ended.

const (
	StopReasonPending  StopReason = "pending"
	StopReasonStop     StopReason = "stop"
	StopReasonLength   StopReason = "length"
	StopReasonToolUse  StopReason = "toolUse"
	StopReasonError    StopReason = "error"
	StopReasonAborted  StopReason = "aborted"
	StopReasonDeferred StopReason = "deferred"
	// Deprecated: use StopReasonToolUse.
	StopReasonToolCalls = StopReasonToolUse
)
type Stream interface {
	Next() (Event, error)
	Close() error
}
    Stream yields normalized model events. Next returns io.EOF after the final
    event. The caller always closes the stream.

type SystemMessage struct {
	Content  string             `json:"content,omitempty"`
	Sections map[string]*string `json:"sections,omitempty"`
	// SectionOrder preserves insertion order, which Go maps cannot express.
	SectionOrder []string        `json:"sectionOrder,omitempty"`
	ToolsAdded   []ToolSpec      `json:"toolsAdded,omitempty"`
	ToolsRemoved []ToolReference `json:"toolsRemoved,omitempty"`
	At           int64           `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
}
    SystemMessage carries instructions and, from the first message on, the tool
    declarations. Later system messages add instructions, replace or remove
    named sections, and add or remove tools.

func AsSystem(message Message) *SystemMessage
    AsSystem returns the message as a system message, or nil.

func GetCurrentSystemMessage(messages []Message) *SystemMessage
    GetCurrentSystemMessage replays every system message in order and returns
    the effective prompt: later content is appended, sections replace or remove
    named sections, and tool declarations accumulate.

func GetInitialSystemMessage(messages []Message) *SystemMessage
    GetInitialSystemMessage returns the leading system message, if any.

func NewSystemMessage(text string) *SystemMessage
    NewSystemMessage creates a system message.

func (m SystemMessage) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
    MarshalJSON adds the role discriminator to a system message.

func (m *SystemMessage) Role() Role
    Role implements Message.

func (m *SystemMessage) SetSection(name string, value *string)
    SetSection sets or removes a named section, preserving insertion order.

func (m *SystemMessage) Text() string
    Text returns the message's text blocks joined without separators.

func (m *SystemMessage) Thinking() string
    Thinking returns the message's thinking blocks joined without separators.

func (m *SystemMessage) Timestamp() int64
    Timestamp returns the message creation time in Unix milliseconds.

func (m *SystemMessage) ToolCalls() []ToolCall
    ToolCalls returns the message's tool calls in source order.

type ThinkingLevel string
    ThinkingLevel is the requested reasoning level for a model turn.

const (
	ThinkingOff     ThinkingLevel = "off"
	ThinkingMinimal ThinkingLevel = "minimal"
	ThinkingLow     ThinkingLevel = "low"
	ThinkingMedium  ThinkingLevel = "medium"
	ThinkingHigh    ThinkingLevel = "high"
	ThinkingXHigh   ThinkingLevel = "xhigh"
	ThinkingMax     ThinkingLevel = "max"
)
type ToolCall struct {
	ID               string          `json:"id"`
	ItemID           string          `json:"itemId,omitempty"`
	Name             string          `json:"name"`
	Arguments        json.RawMessage `json:"arguments"`
	ArgumentsError   string          `json:"argumentsError,omitempty"`
	ThoughtSignature string          `json:"thoughtSignature,omitempty"`
	Namespace        string          `json:"namespace,omitempty"`
}
    ToolCall is a completed tool invocation requested by the model.

func CloneToolCall(call ToolCall) ToolCall
    CloneToolCall deep-copies a tool call.

type ToolCallDelta struct {
	ID             string `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Name           string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	ArgumentsDelta string `json:"arguments_delta,omitempty"`
}
    ToolCallDelta is one streamed fragment of a tool call. ContentIndex on the
    enclosing Event identifies the content block. ID and Name are complete
    values when present; ArgumentsDelta is incremental.

type ToolChoice struct {
	Mode ToolChoiceMode `json:"mode,omitempty"`
	Name string         `json:"name,omitempty"`
}
    ToolChoice selects a tool-use policy. Name is used only with
    ToolChoiceNamed.

type ToolChoiceMode string
    ToolChoiceMode controls how the model may use tools.

const (
	ToolChoiceAuto     ToolChoiceMode = "auto"
	ToolChoiceNone     ToolChoiceMode = "none"
	ToolChoiceRequired ToolChoiceMode = "required"
	ToolChoiceNamed    ToolChoiceMode = "named"
)
type ToolReference struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}
    ToolReference names a tool that stops being available.

type ToolResultMessage struct {
	ToolCallID        string           `json:"toolCallId"`
	ToolName          string           `json:"toolName"`
	Content           []ContentBlock   `json:"content"`
	Details           json.RawMessage  `json:"details,omitempty"`
	StructuredContent json.RawMessage  `json:"structuredContent,omitempty"`
	Usage             *Usage           `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	NestedCalls       *NestedToolCalls `json:"nestedCalls,omitempty"`
	IsError           bool             `json:"isError,omitempty"`
	At                int64            `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
	DurationMs        int64            `json:"durationMs,omitempty"`
}
    ToolResultMessage is the observation returned to the model after a tool
    call.

func AsToolResult(message Message) *ToolResultMessage
    AsToolResult returns the message as a tool-result message, or nil.

func NewToolResultMessage(callID, toolName string, content []ContentBlock, isError bool) *ToolResultMessage
    NewToolResultMessage creates a tool-result message with arbitrary blocks.

func (m ToolResultMessage) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
    MarshalJSON adds the role discriminator to a tool-result message.

func (m *ToolResultMessage) Role() Role
    Role implements Message.

func (m *ToolResultMessage) Text() string

func (m *ToolResultMessage) Thinking() string

func (m *ToolResultMessage) Timestamp() int64

func (m *ToolResultMessage) ToolCalls() []ToolCall

type ToolSpec struct {
	Name        string         `json:"name"`
	Description string         `json:"description"`
	Parameters  map[string]any `json:"parameters"`
}
    ToolSpec describes a tool to the model.

func GetCurrentTools(messages []Message) []ToolSpec
    GetCurrentTools returns the tool set declared by the transcript.

func GetDeclaredTools(messages []Message) []ToolSpec
    GetDeclaredTools is an alias for GetCurrentTools.

type ToolStateChanges struct {
	ToolsAdded   []ToolSpec
	ToolsRemoved []ToolReference
}
    ToolStateChanges is the delta between two tool sets.

func GetToolStateChanges(previous, current []ToolSpec) ToolStateChanges
    GetToolStateChanges computes the declarations needed to turn previous into
    current.

func (c ToolStateChanges) HasToolChanges() bool
    HasToolChanges reports whether the delta is empty.

type TranscriptContext struct {
	Messages []Message
}
    TranscriptContext is a normalized request context: the prompt and tool
    declarations live in the leading system message, never beside the messages.

func NormalizeContext(input Context) TranscriptContext
    NormalizeContext folds SystemPrompt and Tools into a leading system message.

type Transport string
    Transport is a preferred model transport. GOAT currently serves every
    provider over HTTP; "websocket" is rejected by adapters.

const (
	TransportAuto      Transport = "auto"
	TransportSSE       Transport = "sse"
	TransportWebSocket Transport = "websocket"
)
type Usage struct {
	Input        int64 `json:"input"`
	Output       int64 `json:"output"`
	CacheRead    int64 `json:"cacheRead"`
	CacheWrite   int64 `json:"cacheWrite"`
	CacheWrite1H int64 `json:"cacheWrite1h,omitempty"`
	Reasoning    int64 `json:"reasoning,omitempty"`
	TotalTokens  int64 `json:"totalTokens"`
	Cost         Cost  `json:"cost"`
}
    Usage contains token counts and derived cost reported by a model provider.

func (u *Usage) Add(other Usage)
    Add accumulates another usage report.

type UserMessage struct {
	Content []ContentBlock `json:"content"`
	At      int64          `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
}
    UserMessage is a user turn.

func AsUser(message Message) *UserMessage
    AsUser returns the message as a user message, or nil.

func NewUserMessage(content ...ContentBlock) *UserMessage
    NewUserMessage creates a user message.

func (m UserMessage) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
    MarshalJSON adds the role discriminator to a user message.

func (m *UserMessage) Role() Role
    Role implements Message.

func (m *UserMessage) Text() string

func (m *UserMessage) Thinking() string

func (m *UserMessage) Timestamp() int64

func (m *UserMessage) ToolCalls() []ToolCall
